integrity: Algebraic proof is self-contained; finite numerical and rational checks are auxiliary, not substitutes for proof. Classical polyhedral methods and incomplete historical priority remain limitations. No independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Only global positive mass and momentum for freely varying real low-rank core with fixed full-column bases, positive quadrature, nonnegative entries and arbitrary core rank. Does not prove a scheme stability or accuracy theorem, solve least-perturbative optimizer in closed form, handle energy, positive floors, or fixed exact rank.
title: Exact fixed-basis positivity and moment feasibility for low-rank kinetic corrections
